name: Raffles Istanbul
positioning: Contemporary luxury hotel in Zorlu Center on Istanbul's European side, above the Bosphorus, with a large commissioned art collection and a 3,000 sq m hammam spa
best_for: Travelers who want a Bosphorus-view room with its own balcony or terrace
Spa lovers looking for a traditional Turkish hammam in a contemporary setting
Couples, with a couples spa suite that has a private jacuzzi

facts.text: Raffles Istanbul is set in Zorlu Center.
The hotel is on the European side of Istanbul, above the Bosphorus.
The hotel has direct access to high-end shopping and the Zorlu Performing Arts Center.
Nearby, guests can explore Besiktas and Ortakoy, walk along the Bosphorus or visit Dolmabahce Palace.
Every room and suite has floor-to-ceiling windows opening onto a private balcony or terrace.
Raffles Butlers are available around the clock.
Interiors pair contemporary design with a large collection of commissioned art.
Raffles Spa is on the hotel's second floor and covers 3,000 square metres.
Raffles Spa has indoor and outdoor pools.
The Raffles Couples Romance takes place in a spa suite with a private jacuzzi and side-by-side massages.
Isokyo serves pan-Asian cuisine blending Japanese, Thai, Korean and Chinese flavours with Turkish ingredients.
The hotel's venues include Lavinia Lounge for all-day dining and afternoon tea, the Long Bar for cocktails and Writers Bar.

highlights.text: The Raffles Suite is a nine-room suite with marble floors, a grand piano, a private cinema and a gym.
From its hilltop setting, the hotel's panorama stretches from the Black Sea to the Marmara Sea, taking in the Bosphorus and its three bridges.
Raffles Spa was named a Forbes Travel Guide Five-Star Spa in 2025.
Raffles Spa has seven spa suites and three traditional hammams.
The Dream of Istanbul Art Tour is a complimentary tour of the hotel's commissioned artworks.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the modern tower setting may lack traditional Istanbul charm.
WhataHotel notes ultra-luxury pricing reflecting the premium positioning.
